no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it was clear that the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from three adequate and well controlled studies, using clinical trial designs similar to those of trials for previously approved migraine drugs. Moreover, the safety profile was deemed acceptable for the treatment of migraine, without controversial issues.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for BLA761077 (AIMOVIG/erenumab). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from three adequate and well-controlled trials and the safety profile was acceptable without controversial issues; the Medical Review similarly states an advisory committee meeting was not anticipated. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to labeling, REMS, or postmarketing requirements.
